candidates.name: OGC Symbology Conceptual Core Model
verified_facts: The OGC Symbology Conceptual Core Model provides a conceptual basis for defining symbology rules used to portray geographic data.
It is an encoding-agnostic portrayal model with abstract style classes and extension points.
semantic_limits: A style, symbol, renderer or portrayal rule changes presentation, not the measured terrain value, parcel boundary quality or source vertical accuracy.

candidates.name: OGC Publish/Subscribe
verified_facts: OGC Publish/Subscribe defines subscription-management concepts such as creating, renewing and removing subscriptions for OGC Web Services.
Message delivery protocols are independent from the core Publish/Subscribe specification.
semantic_limits: Fast or successful notification delivery does not prove the underlying dataset is current, accurate, parcel-specific or suitable for vertical measurement.
